faq.heading: Personal Injury
faq.text: A personal injury attorney specializes in bringing lawsuits against negligent businesses or individuals on behalf of an injured party to seek damages.

faq.heading: Personal Injury
faq.text: The plaintiff possesses the burden of proof within personal injury cases.

faq.heading: Personal Injury
faq.text: Given this, it’s important to find an attorney with a proven track record in obtaining settlements or winning jury trials.
